run_validators: run a list of Validator objects and return an aggregated ValidationResult and report string
run_validators_aggregate: run multiple validators and aggregate results into a single SUCCESS or FAILED outcome
run_validators_report: run validators and join all ValidationReport strings into an aggregated report
review_run_validators: review the run_validators function that executes a list of Validator instances and returns aggregated results
refactor_run_validators: refactor run_validators to support early exit on the first FAILED validation result
